Verified,Myra Jamin,in progress,4/13/2026 18:00:59,Matthew,Gibson,mjgibson@umich.edu,Bubble tea,,Bubble tea [also known as boba tea
column12: or tapioca milk tea] is a drink that was invented about 40 years ago by two tearooms in Taiwan. Bubble tea contains chewy tapioca pearls called “boba”. The classic flavor has three main ingredients – black tea
column14: and boba – but the term “bubble tea” can refer to any drink that has boba inside
column18: all of which often include one or more flavor syrups. There are also different kinds of boba
column19: like chewy boba made with honey
column20: or fruity boba filled with juice that pops when you bite into it. Some people add extra toppings to their bubble tea
column25: or cheese foam. When you order bubble tea
column26: you can usually ask for it to be made hot or cold
column27: and you can change how much ice or sugar you want in your drink too. Bubble tea has grown more popular in the last ten years
column28: and today there are hundreds of thousands of bubble tea stores around the world!"
